visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 綠豆是「神藥」? [Variety]: 別再喝綠豆湯了. (2) [Subtitle]: 綠豆是被美食耽誤的. (3) [Subtitle]: 傳統醫學早發現. (4) [Subtitle]: 綠豆殼有抗發炎跟抗氧化的功效. (5) [Subtitle]: 而且綠豆不只對你好 也對你的小孩 我是說 毛小孩 竟然也有好處. (6) [Subtitle]: 臺大陳慧文教授 提出大膽的想法. (7) [Logo]: source/臺灣大學. (8) [Subtitle]: 利用綠豆殼萃取物 治療貓咪的絕症 傳染性腹膜炎. (9) [Subtitle]: 結果還真成功了 實驗顯示. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to inform cat owners about a new scientific discovery by NTU researchers using mung bean hull extract to treat Feline Infectious Peritonitis (FIP). It balances this excitement with a practical warning to owners not to feed raw mung bean soup to cats, as they are carnivores.
